newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican filmmaker Gilberto Martinez dies at 90.
newsitem.headline: Mexican filmmaker Gilberto Martinez dies at 90.

text.p: One of Mexico's most prolific filmmakers, Gilberto Martinez Solares, died of a heart attack over the weekend at the age of 90, newspapers reported on Monday.
He was buried on Sunday in the city's Jardin cemetery in the southern neighbourhood of San Angel, which also contains the grave of Mexican film idol Pedro Infante.
"This is an irreplaceable and painful loss for Mexico, for its cinema, and in particular for me, because Gilberto and I were like brothers," fellow filmmaker Gabriel Figueroa said.

Martinez's career in the film industry started in 1935 when he worked as a cameraman on the film "Rosario". Three years later he directed his first full-length feature, "El senor alcalde" (Mr. Mayor).
He directed 150 films and contributed to the rapid growth of Mexico's domestic film industry during its golden age in the 1940s and 1950s.
